text:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting a coordinated feature-flag cutover for model-routing v4 during the 23:00 UTC change window. Plan: pin routing service to v4.2.1 -> v4.2.2, enable new route behind FF, ramp 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% over ~30m with 5m holds.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary group -> 5% at 23:02 UTC. Rollback window: automatic deadman if 5xx rate > 0.5% or latency p95 increases > 2x baseline for 5m. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/model-route-cutover

sam: copying the metrics to watch: model-inference-5xx, global-req-latency-p95, kvcache-hitrate. alerts already wired to #incidents.

kevin: add an extra hold after 20% for 10m — we've seen slow ramp regressions before. Can we make the command two-step so ops can fast-fail?

maria: yes — ops will have a "deadman" toggle. If we hit thresholds, flip to fallback route instantly. Alicia can run the emergency drain if needed.

alicia: I’ll be on standby at 23:00 UTC and monitoring APM + logs. ping me @alicia if anything looks off.

ops-bot: Canary verification checklist: 
 - healthchecks pass on 100% of new instances
 - kvcache warm ratio > 80%
 - no error spike for model-hydration jobs
(automated preflight completed, all green)

deploy-bot: FF command precomputed: 
```
# enable 5% canary for route_v4
ffctl toggle --flag route_v4_new --percent 5 --cohorts canary
# followups: 20 and 60
```

sam: Will we pin traffic to the pinned model version on routing failures? Need to avoid silent model drift.

maria: yes — routing will fallback to pinned v4.2.1 and record telemetry. Rollback playbook: immediate pin and drain if any of these happen -> 5xx > 0.5%, degraded QA evals, or user-facing regressions reported.

kevin: Also logging: include `deploy_id` and `ff_wave` in request logs so we can slice traces.

alicia: Got it. I will validate eval set after 20% ramp and run quick smoke prompts.

maria: Coordinator note: manual approval required before 60% step. I’ll post status updates here at each hold. If anyone wants to abort early, call out in-thread and @deploy-bot will cancel.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 23:02 UTC (route_v4_new = 5%). CI: ok. Observability: collecting APM traces.

sam: seeing one transient spike at 23:04, looks connected to a retry storm from external queue — not related to model. tagging incident-ops.

maria: thanks — keep watching. Next planned action: move to 20% at 23:07 if no flareups.

(23:30) alicia: Post-check — 20% hold ok, evals show parity. Ready for manual approval to 60%.

kevin: +1 from infra. No backend capacity pressure.

maria: approving move to 60%. Deploy-bot, proceed when ready. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Ramp to 60% initiated at 23:33 UTC. Monitoring for deadman conditions.

ops-bot: Reminder: if you need an immediate rollback use: `ffctl toggle --flag route_v4_new --percent 0 --force` and then `routectl pin --service routing --version v4.2.1`.

maria: closing loop — will file release notes and add postmortem checklist after the window. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
